mapper.sql: p.id, p.member_id, p.category, p.title, m.name AS author, p.content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE') AS replies, p.view_count AS views, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM community_post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
SELECT FROM community_post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_post (member_id, category, title, content, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE community_post SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.member_id, m.name AS author, c.content, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM community_comment c JOIN member m ON m.id = c.member_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_comment (post_id, member_id, content, status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE community_comment SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_report WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND reporter_member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_report (post_id, reporter_member_id, reason, detail, status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{reporterMemberId}, #{reason}, #{detail}, 'PENDING')
